tests.name: Effective description
tests.reasoning: The description focuses on user-facing symptoms (access denied errors, query failures across Athena, EMR, Redshift Spectrum, QuickSight) and explicitly lists 'Use when...' trigger contexts, covering both direct and indirect ways users might encounter these issues. It is implementation-light (mentions tracing the authorization chain only as scope clarification, not procedural detail) and is a concise paragraph.
tests.evidence: Use when a principal cannot access a Glue Data Catalog database or table or a Lake Formation-governed resource, or when an Amazon Athena, Amazon EMR, Amazon Redshift Spectrum, or Amazon QuickSight query fails with access denied or a Lake Formation permission error.
